nodes.name: Job Search Webhook
nodes.notes: POST body: { "query": "automation jobs in USA", "keywords": "automation", "location": "USA", "remote": true, "user_id": "...", "user_email": "..." }. Remote-first: remote boards plus remote postings from location boards. Searches every source that covers the location, keeps legit relevant postings, returns { success, jobs, dropped, warnings, cached_at }. Repeat searches within search_cache_minutes come from the cache (cached_at = when fetched). Header Auth: only the n8n-proxy Edge Function (X-Webhook-Secret) may call this.

nodes.name: Plan Job Sources
nodes.notes: SETTINGS at the top: remote boards on/off and cache minutes, Jooble key, SerpApi on/off, default countries, per-search caps. Picks sources by location: Adzuna (19 countries), hh.ru (Russia/CIS), Jooble or Google Jobs (everywhere else).

parameters.jsCode:
// One item per request the plan made for this source.
return $('Plan Job Sources').first().json.remote_misses.map((r) => ({ json: r }));

nodes.name: Remote Board Search
nodes.notes: Jobicy and Remotive (remote-only boards, free, no key). Only runs when the cached result for this query is older than the TTL in Plan Job Sources.

parameters.jsCode:

nodes.name: Adzuna Job Search
nodes.notes: Adzuna: US, CA, MX, BR, UK, DE, FR, NL, BE, AT, CH, ES, IT, PL, AU, NZ, IN, SG, ZA. Free: 25 calls/min, 250/day.

nodes.name: hh.ru Job Search
nodes.notes: hh.ru: Russia, Kazakhstan, Belarus, Uzbekistan. Free, no key; identifies itself with the signed-in user's email (sent by the app as user_email).

nodes.name: Jooble Job Search
nodes.notes: Jooble: 60+ countries, used only where Adzuna and hh.ru do not reach. The free key has a small total request quota.

nodes.name: Google Jobs Search
nodes.notes: Optional paid fallback (use_serpapi in Plan Job Sources).

nodes.name: Rank Jobs
nodes.notes: Merges sources, drops recruitment agencies, scam patterns, off-topic, older than 30 days and duplicates. Newest first, max 60.

nodes.name: People Webhook
nodes.notes: POST body: { "company": "...", "website": "...", "linkedin_url": "...", "location": "...", "roles": ["Founder/CEO", "COO"] }. Finds people from the company website (team, about, contact, imprint pages), Companies House (UK) and optionally LinkedIn. Returns { success, people, company: { website, email, emails }, warnings }. Header Auth: only the n8n-proxy Edge Function (X-Webhook-Secret) may call this.

nodes.name: Build People Query
nodes.notes: USE_LINKEDIN_SEARCH at the top (paid SerpApi). ROLE_TERMS holds the titles matched for each role, including local legal titles (Geschäftsführer, Gérant, Генеральный директор …).

nodes.name: SerpApi LinkedIn Profiles
nodes.notes: Optional: public LinkedIn profiles via Google.

nodes.name: Companies House Search
nodes.notes: UK official register (free key). Only used when the company is in the UK.

nodes.name: Website Candidates
nodes.notes: The site the app sent, else domains guessed from the name and the company's country (.de, .com.au, .co.jp …).

nodes.name: Fetch Homepages
nodes.notes: Unreachable guessed domains are expected and ignored.

nodes.name: Merge People
nodes.notes: Reads people (team cards, schema.org data, imprint 'Managing Director: …' lines) and emails (mailto, plain text, [at] obfuscation, Cloudflare-protected) on the company's own domain, then merges all sources.

nodes.name: API Usage Webhook
nodes.notes: GET, no body. Returns today's third-party API calls: { success, day, reset_at, sources: [{ name, calls, daily_limit, note }] }. Counts are kept in workflow static data, which n8n saves only for production (active workflow) runs. Header Auth: only the n8n-proxy Edge Function (X-Webhook-Secret) may call this.

nodes.name: Report API Usage
nodes.notes: Daily limits per source are in SOURCES at the top.

nodes.name: Cached Result?
nodes.notes: Same search within search_cache_minutes (Plan Job Sources): respond from the cache.
